note: Every request issued to the trainee concierge team in the WhatsApp retail training group. Requesters (Advita, Anishqa, Ananyshree, Syndia, Savio, Vikram) were role-playing as members. 'Team' = thrown to the group rather than named. This file is the auditable source for the Academy curriculum (migration 130).

standing_rules.detail: Under a minute. If you say 'shortly', define it — 5 minutes, 50 minutes or 5 hours.
Communication like a human, not a bot and not GPT. No empty acknowledgements — 'noted', 'checking' — with nothing behind them.
The member has the best tools already. Find the data and then help them decide. Do not send five options and ask which one.
Cost, location, distance, ETA, link and menu should be in the first message. Never make the member ask twice.
Check history, cuisine preference, veg/non-veg, past orders and budget before recommending. If the team already has the detail, do not ask for it.
Consolidate. Fragmented messages across a thread read as disorganised.
Every response carries the time by when a revert will come, and the commitment is kept.
Track orders and deliveries yourself. If the member has to follow up, they do not need a concierge.
Use INR where relevant, keep a consistent decimal format, name files cleanly, and always include the link.
Check the restaurant is open, the queue time, whether the size exists, whether the dimensions match. Check first, send second.
Clean but not fake communication even when the member is agitated. Never respond selectively or go silent.
Every task goes into FD so status is visible without anyone asking.
